form.label: Regulator runs
form.description: Everything Regulator ships over HEC, by run. Samples every 5 s from the control plane, one record per search from the workers, the run summary at the end, and the lifecycle in between.

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:lifecycle kind=run_created | stats latest(_time) as t, latest(run_label) as run_label, latest(scenario) as scenario by run_no | sort - t | eval label=run_label." (".scenario.")"
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:step | rex field=run_id "^r(?<run_no>\d+)" | search run_no=$run$
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | stats latest(executions) as executions by run_no | stats sum(executions) as executions
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | stats latest(cum.p95_ms) as p95 by run_no | stats max(p95) as p95 | eval p95=round(p95, 0)

index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | stats latest(executions) as executions, latest(errors) as errors by run_no | stats sum(executions) as executions, sum(errors) as errors | eval rate=if(executions>0, round(100*errors/executions, 2), 0)."%" | fields rate
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | stats max(in_flight) as peak
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | timechart max(interval.p95_ms) as p95 by run_label limit=10
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ NOT slot=* | timechart sum(interval.throughput_per_s) as "searches/s", sum(in_flight) as "in flight", sum(interval.queued) as "queued in Splunk"
search ok=false | timechart count by error_class

search ok=true | stats count as searches, p50(latency_ms) as p50_ms, p95(latency_ms) as p95_ms, p99(latency_ms) as p99_ms, avg(queued_ms) as avg_queued_ms, avg(run_duration_s) as avg_run_s by step_id, step_class | foreach *_ms avg_run_s [eval <<FIELD>>=round('<<FIELD>>', 1)] | sort - p95_ms | head 20

panel.title: Per worker: p95 latency per interval (fleet runs)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ slot=* | eval worker=run_label." slot ".slot | timechart max(interval.p95_ms) by worker limit=20

index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:sample run_no=$run$ slot=* | stats latest(executions) as searches, latest(errors) as errors, latest(cum.p95_ms) as p95_ms, latest(interval.throughput_per_s) as per_s, latest(in_flight) as in_flight by run_label, slot | eval p95_ms=round(p95_ms, 0)

index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:run scope!=worker run_no=$run$ | eval p95_ms=round('stats.latency.p95_ms', 0), error_pct=round('stats.error_rate_pct', 2) | table _time, run_no, run_label, scenario, target, fleet, outcome, valid, stats.executions, p95_ms, error_pct, invalid_reason | rename stats.executions as searches | sort - _time
index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:lifecycle run_no=$run$ | eval detail=coalesce(outcome, reason, worker, 'findings{}') | table _time, run_label, kind, slot, detail | sort - _time | head 200

index=$idx$ sourcetype=regulator:health | stats latest(_time) as last_seen, latest(version) as version, latest(active_runs) as active_runs, latest(uptime_s) as uptime_s by host | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), uptime=tostring(round(uptime_s), "duration") | fields - uptime_s
